newsitem.title: DENMARK: FLS sells data unit to US EDS Corporation.
newsitem.headline: FLS sells data unit to US EDS Corporation.

text.p: Danish engineering group FLS Industries said on Monday it sold its FLS Data unit to United States' information technology firm EDS (Electronic Data Systems Corporation).
It said that it planned at the same time to enter a strategic cooperation alliance with EDS and that it the final deal was subject to the normal due diligence stipulations.

FLS said both parties had decided not to divulge the sales sum but added that it expected the purchase by EDS of the entire shareholding in the unit to have a "considerably positive effect" on FLS's 1997 result.

"For FLS' data organisation, the cooperation deal with EDS, the world's leading IT-service organisation, means that FLS will be able to extend its areas of business activity and expertise," the company said in a statement. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
